notice: Court details were checked against city, city-operated recreation, venue-operator, and USA Pickleball sources on October 2, 2026. This directory describes published access policies; it does not show live availability. Follow current venue schedules and posted signs before playing.

courts.name: Recreation Park Courts
courts.courtDescription: Outdoor sports complex. The current city booking portal refers to pickleball Courts 1–8; an older city overview says four courts.
courts.access: Free walk-on play when unreserved. Paid reservations and city programs take priority.
rules: Private paid instruction and unapproved organized activities are prohibited.
Water only on the courts; no pets, glass, or wheeled vehicles.
limits: Court-count descriptions differ between official sources; confirm the current setup with the Checkout Building at 310-524-2700.
courts.scheduleNote: The city-operated portal publishes 8 AM–10 PM. Check its current calendar for reserved courts and programs.

courts.name: Manhattan Beach Middle School Courts
courts.address: 1501 N. Redondo Avenue, Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
courts.courtDescription: Five open-play courts and one beginner court.
courts.setup: School-site courts with limited public access
courts.access: Free public play on weekends and MBUSD breaks and holidays.
rules: Follow the challenge-court rules posted at the venue.
limits: The city does not publish ordinary weekday-after-school public access on this page. Gate access is not guaranteed.
courts.scheduleNote: Published public window: 8 AM–dusk on weekends and MBUSD breaks and holidays.

courts.name: Manhattan Heights Park Courts
courts.address: 1600 Manhattan Beach Boulevard, Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
courts.courtDescription: Drop-in setup expands to seven courts except Wednesday mornings, when three are listed.
courts.access: Paid reservations or scheduled drop-in. Hourly rates: $12 residents / $16 nonresidents. Daily drop-in: $3 / $4.
rules: Reserve online; maximum two one-hour reservations per day.
limits: The page gives conflicting closing hours. Check the city's booking calendar.
courts.scheduleNote: Published drop-in: weekday mornings, Monday/Friday evenings, and Saturday evenings; verify the current session.

courts.name: Dee Hardison Sports Center
courts.courtDescription: Indoor adult drop-in at Wilson Park's sports center.
courts.access: Online registration is required. Published fee: $5 per person; ages 18+; capacity 30.

courts.name: Memorial Park Pickleball Courts
courts.courtDescription: Sixteen pickleball courts share four tennis courts.
courts.access: First come, first served outside city programs and approved permits. Organized drop-in uses registration and a paddle queue.
rules: When players wait, use the paddle queue and do not drill.
Follow city staff and posted rotation rules.
limits: Registration windows differ for residents and nonresidents. Walk-in registration is accepted only if space remains.
courts.scheduleNote: Organized sessions are published for weekday evenings and weekends. The page has inconsistent weekend end times; check the current registration listing.

courts.name: Kelly Courts
courts.courtDescription: The current facility page lists four pickleball courts beside Clark Field.
courts.access: Confirm with Parks and Recreation at 310-318-0280. The linked policy permits free unreserved walk-on play and limits reservations to resident members.
rules: The linked policy restricts equipment and requires city approval for instruction; check the current posted policy.
limits: The facility page lists 9 AM–7 PM daily. Its linked PDF still gives a restricted Tuesday–Saturday schedule and says Courts 3 and 4 are closed. These official sources conflict.
courts.scheduleNote: Current hours and the number of usable courts need confirmation. No availability is implied.

courts.name: California Smash
courts.address: 815 N. Nash Street, El Segundo, CA 90245
courts.courtDescription: Nine indoor padded courts at a privately operated pickleball and social club.
courts.access: Open to the public without membership. Paid hourly court bookings use CourtReserve; classes and scheduled open play are also listed.
limits: Prices vary by court type and selected time. The booking page and footer give different weekday and Sunday closing hours; confirm the selected session with the operator at 310-295-4048.
courts.scheduleNote: Use the operator's current booking calendar. A listed facility or program does not imply an available court.
